# Overview 

Maddy B. has completed photo analysis for oyster growth at the Sequim site from the 05/31/2026 assessment. This brings analysis of Sequim growth up to date with the most recent assessment.  

There are two projects deployed at Sequim Bay: 1) PolyIC cross-generational immune priming projecct and 2) thermal hardening project (Effort A).  

In the PolyIC project, parent broodstock were immersed in PolyIC and performance is measured on offspring outplants over the last 2 years.  

In the Effort A thermal hardening project, we exposed USDA general excess oysters to two weeks of daily exposure to ~6 h of +10°C conditions and deployed alongside controls. 

## tl;dr 

There was no effect of immune or thermal hardening treatments on field growth.  

## Data and code 

### PolyIC project 

Data from this assessment are available on [GitHub here](https://github.com/RobertsLab/polyIC-larvae/tree/main/data/outplant/sequim). The code used to analyse the data is also on [GitHub here](https://github.com/RobertsLab/polyIC-larvae/blob/main/scripts/outplant/growth_SequimBay.Rmd). 

### Thermal hardening project (Effort A)

Data from this assessment are available on [GitHub here](https://github.com/RobertsLab/project-gigas-conditioning/tree/main/data/outplanting/Sequim). The code used to analyse the data is also on [GitHub here](https://github.com/RobertsLab/project-gigas-conditioning/blob/main/code/growth_SequimBay.Rmd).

No effect of treatment.

# PolyIC cross-generational project 

![]()

There was no effect of treatment, only an increase in size with time.  

```
Type III Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method
               Sum Sq Mean Sq NumDF   DenDF F value    Pr(>F)    
treatment         524     524     1    6.01  0.5342    0.4923    
date            67246   33623     2 2501.11 34.2616 2.092e-15 ***
treatment:date   3351    1676     2 2501.11  1.7075    0.1815   
```

Survival was calculated at the level of each bag and was not different between treatments.
